RIH with 30" conductor x-over joint and installing cement top-up system with cement outlet 35 m below mud line.
Changed 30" conductor bails and elevator to to 5 1/2" DP handling equipment.

Run 30" conductor on 5 1/2" landing string.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: WOW. Made up cmt stinger inside 30" conductor. Run 30" conductor and stabbed same into template guide funnel. Run 30" conductor to 169 m. Washed down from 169 m.

Pulled back one single. Broke connection using the iron roughneck. Continued to RIH. Stabbed conductor into guide funnel at 03:30 hrs. Checked orientation of conductor shoe. Recovered broken off piece of top up cement piping.
Held tool box meeting with oncoming crew. Washed down with 30" conductor from 169 to 180 m, 1000 lpm.

Guided the conductor carefully through the guide funnel to 180.2 m to avoid further damage on top up cement piping. Washed down with 30" conductor from 180.2 m to 190 m, 1000 lpm. Observed leakage in top up cement piping at approx. 11 m below top housing.

Held a tool box meeting prior to rig down the cement line.
Retracted centralizer dogs on template. Picked up 0,5 m  to confirm conductor free, free up weight 124 ton, no excess drag.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: Run 30" conductor, washed down from 169 m to TD at 196.8 m. Verified TD with digiquartz measurements. Circulated prior to cement job. Closed the centraliser Rams and verified same with the ROV. Checked depth with digiquartz; 43 cm below F-7.
Pumped 15 m³ 1.65 SG mud and applied 20 bars back pressure to IBOP.

Bled off pressure and checked for back-flow. Removed cement hose and flushed through manifolds and hoses.
Waited on cement to set. Meanwhile performed general maintenance.

Opened centralizer rams on F-14. Retrieved the hot stab from bank # 4.

Continued POOH with landing string, measured same with laser.

Rigged casing running equipment. Installed casing bails.

Held toolbox talk with new crew for continued casing running operations and rigging up elevator tilit adapter. Recieved equipment from Sleipner.

Ran 14" 96,6# casing from 74 m to 207 m MD. Filled every casing joint with 1,30 sg WBM.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: Rigged up 14" casing running equipment.  Made repairs on BX elevator. Ran shoejoints and threadlocked. Ran 14" casing to 610 m MD.

activities.remarks: Ran 14" 96,6# casing from 207 m to 610 m MD. Filled every casing joint with 1,30 sg WBM. Static losses approx 100 l/hrs after midnight.
Ran 14" 96,6# casing from 610 m to 1077 m MD. Filled every casing joint with 1,30 WBM. Laid out joint #120 due to jammed protector on box end.

Ran 14 96,6# casing from 1077 m to 1540 m MD. Filled every casing joint with 1,30 WBM.

Ran 14 96,6# casing from 1540 m to 1874 m MD. Filled every casing joint with 1,30 WBM. Laid out joint #48 due to jammed protector on box end.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: Ran 14" 96,6# casing from 610 m to 2131 m MD. Picked up and made up 14" casing hanger / PADPRT.

activities.remarks: Ran 14 96,6# casing from 1874 m to 2126 m MD. Filled every casing joint with 1,30 WBM. Laid out joint #48 due to jammed protector on box end. Joint #14 & #13 added to tally due to lay outs. Meanwhile tested CRI hose to 200 bar. Leakage 3% / 10 min.

Removed FMS from rotary.
Installed master bushing. Checked casing hanger and PADPRT.
Held toolbox talk prior to removing casing tong.
Rigged down Odfjell casing tong.
RIH with 14" casing / PADPRT on 5 1/2" HWDP from 2134 m to 2233 m MD.

On last stand prior to landing casing hanger, broke circulation and staged up pumps : 220 lpm/13 bar, 220 lpm/15 bar, 490 lpm/16 bar. Took 10-12 MT weight at 2243 m MD. Increased flowrate to 1500 lpm / 28 bar. Washed down to 2273 m MD.
Picked up and made up cement head. Hooked up cement hose and controls.
Washed down 14" casing with 550 lpm/18 bar down to 2276 m MD. Landed hanger at 140,84 m MD and set down 7 MT.
Staged up pumps to 2300 lpm / 42 bar. Circulated hole clean piror to cementing. Got a lot of cuttings and cavings over the shakers.

Pumped 20 m3 1,60 sg tuned spacer at 2300 lpm. Lined up cement pump. Dropped 1 3/4" ball for 1st wiper plug. Mixed and pumnped 34,5 m3 1,9 sg cement. Pump rate 500-600 lpm / CUP 15-22 bar. Released dart for 2nd wiper plug and displaced with 2,5 m3 WBM from cement unit. Lined up mud pumps for displacing cement with WBM.
Zeroed stroke counter. Displaced cement with 1,30 sg WBM at 3000 lpm. Bumped wiper plug after 7780 strokes (~97% pump efficiency) by observing 70 bar pressure increase.

Lined over to cement pump and tested 14" casing against float collar / wiper plug to 345 bar / 15 min - ok.  Pumped and bled back 2000 litres. No additional flowback observed - floats holding pressure.
Set PADPRT in position to set MS seal by applying 30 MT overpull and setting down while rotating 4 times clockwise.
Pressure tested surface lines agains kil HCR to 207 bar - ok.
Closed upper pipe rams. Pressurized bulk seal in PADPRT to 207 bar to set MS-seal. Vented DP to athmosphere.

Tested seal assembly to 35 bar / 5 min - ok.  Increased pressure to 345 bar - pressure leaked off at approx 3-4 bar / 10 min - trend not improving. Took addtional 10 MT overpull (block 118  MT). Repeated 345 bar test on MS seal with same result. Pumped and bled back approx 400 liter.
Not able to obtain 345 bar test on MS-seal - steady leak off 3-4 bar / 10 min (>1%). Bled off pressure and closed additional valves in kill manifold. Greased valves on cement unit.
Perfomed line test against HCR, 345 bar / 4 bar drop in 10 min. Attempted to re-test MS-seal. Observed volume mismatch and wrong line-up - bled off pressure.

Attempted to re-test MS-seal. Pressurized MS seal to 345 bar / 3 bar drop in 10 min but trend not improving. Closed isolation valve on cement unit and monitored pressure on kill manifold from Gesoservice. Pressure Dropped from 329 to 320 bar in 30 min but no improvement observed. Discussed situation. Dedcided to work on valves and lines to obtain better line test before reverting to testing MS-seal.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: Rigged down casing running equipment. RIH with 14" casing/PADPRT on 5 1/2" HWDP. Washed down casing. Picked up cement head and landed casing at 2276 m MD. Circulated hole clean . Pumped 1,60 sg tuned spacer. Mixed and pumped 34,5 m3 1,90 sg cement. Bumped plug and tested casing to 345 bar. Set seal assembly. Not able to obtain test on MS seal. Troubleshot situation. Re-energized MS-seal. Tested MS-seal to 345 bar-ok. Not able to release PADPRT.

activities.remarks: Greased and operated valves on kill manifold and in moonpool. Changed valve #33 and #35 on cement unit. Greased valves on cement unit. Drained mud from cement unit and filled tanks with water.
Pressure tested cement unit against isolation valve. Obtained test to 345 bar with 1,3 bar drop / 10 min.

Tested kill line against valve in moonpool and K3 valve on kill manifold. Pressurized to 35 bar, dropped 0,5 bar / 5 min - ok. Pressurized to 345 bar, dropped 0,7 bar / 5 min - ok. 

Tested kill line against HCR valves. Pressurized to 35 bar, dropped 0,5 bar / 5 min - ok. Pressurized to 345 bar, dropped 1 bar / 5 min -ok.

Lined up to test MS-seal from above. Pressurized to 35 bar, dropped 0,6 bar 5 min - ok. Pressurized to 345 bar. Pressure dropped 0,7 bar / 5 min in the start but with gradually increasing fall off trend. Dropped 1,8 bar / 5 min towards the end of the test.  Pumped and bled back 373 liter. Bled off pressure and discussed situation. Decided to re-attempt pressurizing MS seal with PADPRT tool.

Re-sat PADPRT by applying 30 MT overpull. Pressurized to 207 bar to re-energize MS-seal. Held pressure for 10 min / 1,3 bar drop (0,5%). Slacked off overpull on PADPRT to relax bulk seal. Took 30 MT overpull to expose MS-seal.

Lined up to pressure test MS seal from above. Pressurized to 35 bar, pressure dropped 0,4 bar / 5 min - ok. Pressurized to 345 bar. Pressure dropped at 1,7 bar / 5 min in the beginning but improved towards the end of the test to 0,5 bar / 5 min. Last 10 min 1,1 bar drop (0,32%) - ok. Pumped and bled back 400 liter. Lost 20 MT on block while performing test.
Attempted to released PADPRT by slacking off weight and applying 4 rigihthand turns - nogo. Discussed situation.
Discussed way forward with regards to releasing PADPRT. Repeated PADPRT release procedure but got same negative result.
Awaited instructions for releasing PADPRT.

Reverted to emergency release procedure. Rotated string 13 times counterclockwise until torque bulid up of 10 000 Nm. Attempted to pull free with 40 MT overpull - nogo. Repeated emergency release procedure but got same negative result.
Awaited instructions for releasing PADPRT. Meeting ongoing with town.
Held toolbox talk for attempt to free PADPRT with straight pull release.
Stepped up hookload. Released PADPRT with 60 MT overpull. Observed 30 MT continuos drag after release.
Staged up pumps to 2650 lpm / SPP 25 bar. Circulated riser clean. Got fines over shakers.
Broke out and laid down cement head.
POOH with PADPRT on 5 1/2" HWDP fdrom 137 m MD to surface. Laid out PADPRT. Found tool cavities packed with cuttings.
Held toolbox talk prior to running wearbushing.
Made up jet sub and testable WBRRT.

Lined up kill manifold for re-testing MS-seal. Closed UPR. Conducted line test against HCR to 345 bar / 5 min, dropped 0,6 bar - ok.

Attempted to replicate test on MS seal testing against WBRRT. Conducted low pressure test to 35 bar / 5 min - ok. Pressured up to 345 bar, not able to obtain good test, pressure leaked off at approx 3,5 bar / 10 min (~1%) and did not stabilize. Topped up drillpipe and observed for flow up drillpipe. Observed flow from drillpipe. Discussed situation. Decided to pull WBRRT and install test plug for test of MS-seal and BOP.
POOH with WBBRT from 140 m MD to surface. Laid down WBBRT.
Made up BOP test plug. RIH with BOP test plug on 5 1/2" DP from surface to 140 m MD.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: Attempted to release PADPRT - negative. Discussed situation with town. Pulled PADPRT free with 60 MT overpull. Cleaned riser and POOH with PADPRT. Ran wearbushing and cleaned wellhead. Attmepted to re-test MS seal against WBRRT - negative. POOH with WBRRT. Ran BOP test plug. Tested BOP and obtained good test on MS-seal.

activities.remarks: Set plug in wearbushing according to Vetco instructions. Lined up for testing BOP and MS seal from cement unit.
Pressure tested BOP. Attempted to get test on MS-seal on BOP test #1 against LPR. Pressured up to 345 bar, leaked off at 2 bar / 10 min but did not stabilize.
Pressure tested BOP (test #2).
Pressure tested BOP, test #3 against UPR. Simultaneously pressure tested MS seal to 345 bar. Obtained test result of 1,3 bar / 10 min (0,37%) and improving trend - ok.
Pressure tested BOP (test #4 to #7).
Pressure tested BOP (test #7 and #8). Reverted to repair on TDS.

Made up test swage to TDS and connected cement hose. Flushed and pressure tested line.
Pressure tested upper/lower IBOPs and kelly hose to 35/345 bar 5/10 min - ok.
Rigged down test swage and laid out same.
Continued working on TDS allignment cylinder.
POOH with BOP test plug on 5 1/2" DP from 140 m MD to surface.
Continued working on TDS allignment cylinder. Picked up single and installed in rotary for making final allignment on TDS.

Used 4 attempts to downlink to Schlumberger powerdrive. Meanwhile drilled ahead with limited ROP from 2704 m to 2713 m.

Used several attempts to downlink to Schlumberger powerdrive. Meanwhile drilled ahead with limited ROP from 2754 m to 2772 m.

activities.remarks:

POOH with 12 1/4" BHA from 2259 m to 133 m.

Continue RU 9 5/8" csg running equipment.

PU shoe joint.

RIH with 10 3/4" x 9 5/8" csg on 5 1/2" HWDP landing string from 2640 to 2779 m MD.
Ball dropped out when PU cement head. Reloaded ball and MU cmt head. Lined up and pressure tested cmt line 345 bar / 5 min.
Established circulation at 1500 lpm / 42 bar and washed down from 2779 m to 2783 m. Landed off 10 3/4" x 9 5/8" csg at 140.5 m and sat down 5 ton. Kept 5 ton on landing string.
Circulated casing volume and btms up, a total of 1150 strks, at 1770 lpm / 53 bar loss free rate. Observed 3 m3/hr loss at 2000 lpm but had full return at 1770 lpm.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: RIH with 10 3/4" x 9 5/8" csg from 1763 to 2640 m MD. RIH with 10 3/4" casing hanger / PADPRT assembly on 5 1/2" HWDP landing string to 2783 m. Landed 10 3/4" x 9 5/8" csg. Circulated, pumped and displaced cement. Pressure tested csg to 345 bar / 15 min.

activities.remarks: Continued circulating casing volume and btms up at 1770 lpm / 53 bar loss free rate. Meanwhile held pre-job meeting for cmt job.
Pumped 30 m3 contaminated OBM, 5 m3 base oil and 19 m3 spacer at 1550-1770 lpm / 46-53 bar.
Verified correct line-up by holding and releasing 20 bar through low torque. Mixed and pumped 13,7 m3 1.90 sg cement slurry at 800 lpm / 31 bar.

Pumped 500 ltrs water, released dart and continued pumping 2500 ltrs water behind cement with cmt unit. Top wiper plug sheared at 170 bar. 

Zeroed stroke counters for mud pumps. Displaced and sheared btm wiper plug by pumping OBM at 1200 lpm using rig pumps. 
Continued displacing cement with 111.9 m3 OBM at 1770-1500 lpm using mud pumps. Wiper plug sheared at 114 bar / 4450 stks. Slowed down rate to 1000 lpm / 69 bar (FCP) approx 4 m3 prior to bump. Bumped plug with 138 bar after pumping 5080 strokes, which gives a pump efficiency of 96.5%. No losses during displacement.

Equalized pressure with cmt unit and opened lo-torque valve. Pressured up well to 345 bar / 15 min to test casing using cmt unit. Ok. 1250 ltrs pumped and got 1220 ltrs back. Bleed off from 345 bar to 138 bar and checked for back flow to cmt unit. Lined over to rig pumps and bled off from 138 bar to zero on stand pipe. Checked for back flow. Disconnected cmt hoses and flushed lines.
Reduced weight on landing string from 5 mT to neutral and released PADPRT. LD cmt head std. Dropped sponge balls and flushed string using mud. POOH and LD PADPRT.

PU and RIH with lock down sub from surface to 140 m. Landed lock down sub and made 4 1/4 turns CW, torque 1700 Nm with neutral weight. Toolstring dropped 7.7 inches. Attempted to to set lock down sub. No go.

1) Performed line test from cmt unit to HCR valve, 30/220 bar 5/10 min. Ok.
2) Pressured up to set lock down sub against closed top pipe ram. No go.
3) Checked for possible leaks in toolstring by opening IBOP and monitor gain in trip tank. No leak observed.
4) Pressured up to set lock down sub against closed btm pipe ram. No go.
5) Pulled lock down sub 1 m above landing no go. Flushed wellhead with 1100 lpm / 15 min.  Landed lock down sub and made 4 1/4 turns CW, torque 1700 Nm with neutral weight. Toolstring dropped 8 inches. Attempted to set lock down sub. No go.
POOH with lock down sub assembly from 140 m to OOH. Checked lock down sub and verified space out. Ok. LD lock down sub.
PU and RIH with jet/flush tool from surface to 140 m. Landed out on 140.03 m.
Jetted top of 10 3/4" csg hanger, 750 lpm / 42 bar / 3 rpm / 2 kNm.
POOH with jet/flush tool from 140 m to OOH. Inspected jetting tool and found indication that tool had not landed out on 10 3/4" csg hanger.
RIH with jet/flush tool from surface to 140 m.

Landed out with jet/flush tool on 10 3/4" csg hanger with 2 mT. PU and established circulation at 910 lpm / 49 bar / 3 rpm / 2 kNm. Tagged with 2 mT serveral times to clean the CH area. PU 1 m and circulated btms up at 930 lpm / 45 bar.
POOH with jet/flush tool from 139 m to 100 m.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: Released and POOH with csg running string from 140.5 m to OOH. LD cmt head and PADRT. RIH to 140 m and attempted to install lock down sub. No go. POOH. MU and RIH with jet/flush tool to 140 m to clean top of 10 3/4" csg hanger area. Re-ran jet/was tool due to poor indication of landing on top of casing hanger. RIH at 40 m to made second attempt to install lock down sub.

activities.remarks: POOH with jet/flush tool from 100 m to 60 m. Could not rack back 5 1/2" HWDP due to finger on FWD PRS not working.
Repaired decoder for finger on FWD PRS.

POOH with jet/flush tool from 600 m to OOH. Inspected jetting tool and found indication that tool had not landed out completely on 10 3/4" csg hanger. Decided that it was no point in re-running the jet/wash tool.
PU and RIH with lock down sub from surface to 40 m. Could not rack back 5 1/2" HWDP due to finger on fingerboard not working.

Repaired decoder for finger on FWD PRS.

Meanwhile changed out drilling bails and performed derrick inspection.
RIH with lock down sub from 40 to 140 m.

Landed lock down sub with 9 mT and made 4 1/4 turns CW, torque 1700 Nm with neutral weight. Toolstring dropped 7.5 inches. Closed UPR and verified correct line-up. 
Attempted to pressure up to 35 bar without sucess. Switched to second cmt pump and re-tried pumping up to 35 bar. Ok. Continued pressuring up to 207 bar and sat MS seal. Bled off pressure to zero. Confirmed lock by taking 40 mT overpull.
Tested MS in lock down sub 35/345 bar for 5/10 min. Ok
Released PADPRT and POOH with running string from 140 m to OOH.
Held tool box meeting prior to running RTTS. MU and RIH with jet sub from surface to 30 m and jetted BOP, 3100 lpm / 22 bar / 10 rpm.
Continue RIH with jet sub on 4 stds of 5 1/2" HWDP from 30 m to 87 m. PU and MU RTTS w/storm valve. Ran Halliburton centrilizer on single above storm valve.
RIH with 10 3/4" RTTS w/SSCV on 5 1/2" DP from 87 m to 350 m. Up weight 92 mT / down weight 97 mT.
Reciprocated string and circulated at 290 lpm / 7 bar to clean setting area. Installed RTTS with elements at 350 m and sat down 20 mT, down weight 70 mT.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: RIH with lock down sub on PADPRT from 40 m to 140 m. Installed lock down sub. POOH. MU, RIH and set RTTS at 350 m MD.  Leak tested RTTS below to 230 bar/10 min. Released from RTTS and attempted to leak test RTTS/Storm valve from above. No go.

activities.remarks:
Lined up to test RTTS from below. Verified correct line-up from cmt unit to IBOP and performed line test. No go. Closed manual IBOP on TDS and performed line test. Ok. 

Performed low pressure test to 30 bar / 10 min. Ok. Dropped 1 bar / 10 min. Pressured up in steps and tested RTTS to 230 bar / 10 min from below. Ok. Dropped 1.8 bar / 10 min. 1.3 m3 pumped and 1.35 m3 bled back.
PU up to neutral and released from RTTS with 22 turns CCWW. PU to 340 m.
Pulled up and greased top of connection. Ran back down to and spaced out below btm pipe ram.

Lined up cmt unit to IBOP on TDS to test RTTS from above and performed line test to 345 bar. Ok.

Performed low pressure test to 30 bar / 10 min. Ok. Dropped 0 bar / 10 min. Pressured up in steps to test RTTS. Pumped 1.1 m3 to 110 bar and observed leak. 500 ltrs bleed back.
Discussed situation and evaluated further action.
Discussed situation and evaluated further action.

Stung back into RTTS. Observed 2.2 bar pressure increase when communication to volume below plug was established. 

Lined up to test RTTS from below. Closed manual IBOP on TDS. Performed low pressure test to 30 bar / 10 min. Ok. Dropped 0 bar / 10 min. Pressured up in steps and tested RTTS to 230 bar / 10 min from below. Ok. Dropped 1.7 bar / 10 min. 1.33 m3 pumped and 1.32 m3 bled back.

Rotated 12 turns to the left and POOH of RTTS. Tested storm valve to 50 bar / 10 min. Ok. Dropped 0.9 bar / 10 min.  121 ltrs pumped and 121 ltrs bled back. Stung out of RTTS.

Flow checked well prior to displacing well above RTTS to SW. Ok. Meanwhile held tool box talk with involved personnel. Drained trip tank and poor boy degasser. Re-filled trip tank with SW. Displaced well to SW at 3100 lpm / 20 bar. Flushed C & K and surface lines.
Pumped 10 m3 hi-vis pill at 1500 lpm / 15 bar and spotted above RTTS.
POOH with running tool on 5 1/2" DP from 348 m to 310 m. Could not rack back 5 1/2" DP due spinner on iron roughneck not working.
Investigated problem with pipe spinner on aft roughneck.
Held tool box meeting prior to using chain tong to spin out stds of DP.

Observed gain in trip tank and flow up RTTS running string. Installed kick valve on string. Shut in well and monitored pressures. No increase in pressure observed. Total gain in trip tank was 420 ltrs.

Opened auto choke and observed no gain in TT through mud gas separator. Opened kick valve and observed no flow. POOH with running tool on 5 1/2" DP from 310 m to 292 m. Could not rack back 5 1/2" DP due to lower arm on FWD PRS not working.

Changed out solenoid valve on lower arm on FWD PRS.

Meanwhile removed every second bolt on slick joint and moved BOP carrier beneath BOP.
Held tool box talk for manual handling. Performed equipment check and found loose dies on FWD PRS carrier. Changed dies.
POOH with running tool on 5 1/2" DP from 292 m to OOH.
Cleared rig floor. RIH with 1 single 5 1/2" DP and closed ram. Drained BOP.
Installed diverter pulling tool.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: Leak tested RTTS to 230 bar from below. Displaced well to sea water above plug. POOH with RTTS running tool and LD same. ND and LO diverter.

activities.remarks: Continued installing diverter pulling tool and POOH with diverter.
LO diverter.
Continued LO diverter.
RU for pulling slick joint. Pulled master bushing. Pulled and LO slick joint.
Removed tension cylinders from BOP.

Removed slings from TDS. PU claxton tool using BX-elevator and ran Claxton tool through rotary. Installed master bushings and 5 1/2" DP slips.

Meanwhile unbolted NT2 connector on BOP.
Helt tool box meeting. Moved BOP to stump. MU NT2 connector to stump and adjusted scaffolding according to Vetco request.
Held tool box meeting. MU Claxton tool to 5 1/2" DP and installed NT2 connector on to HPDR.

Held tool box meeting before removing tension cylinders. Transfered weight from riser tension system to TDS. PU up to 130 mT. Dismantled tensioner ring system.

Meanwhile dismantled annular and cleaned lines from cmt unit through kill, choke and poorboy degasser. Installed cradle and trolly on HTS.

Removed moonpool hatch on F-14 and hatch on F-13 for guide wire. Ran 10 mT tugger to moonpool. Production shut down confirmed at 23:55.

Meanwhile function tested riser spider.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: ND slick joint and BOP. Ran in and MU claxton tool NT-2 running tool to HPDR. RD tension cylinders, tensioner ring and centralizer. Shut down production. Installed hot stab and unlocked TBC. Pulled TBC out of WH. Installed riser spider. POOH with HPDR. Started to brake upper flange on HPDR tension joint.

activities.remarks: Slacked off weight from 129 mT to 110 mT to have TBC in neutral. Installed guide wire using 10 mT tugger. Launched hotstab on mini-reel hose down to seabed, attached to guidewire. Removed dummy hot stab and installed hydraulic hot stab into receptacle at top of TBC using ROV.
Operated TBC valve panel to "Primary unlock" 2-1-1 using ROV and pressured up through mini-reel to 3000 psi. Held pressure for 15 min and confirmed position of indicator rods and unlock band.
Pulled riser 1.5 m above WH using 10-20 mT overpull. Disconnected hot stab and retrieved same.
POOH with riser until connection for 5 1/2" DP was above rotary. Disconnected 5 1/2" DP from Claxton tool and RB same. MU and RB RT for production riser.

PU riser and removed master bushings and ring.  Positioned split spider and installed same.

Meanwhile inspected seal faces in WH and installed debris cover on F-14 using ROV.

Pulled HPDR out until first double was above riser spider. Removed fairing on connection using fairing handling tool. Engaged spider dogs and inserted stop bolts. Landed HPDR upper flange on tension joint in riser spider.

Removed plastic thread protectors and broke flange connection using Bandak tool.
Broke flange connection on first double using Bandak tool. LO first double with Claxton tool using main crane and TDS.

Continued to pull and LO HPDR to deck. 

Meanwhile brushed and cleaned wellhead using ROV.
Held tool box meeting for removing hatch on F-15 and moving riser guide funnel from F-3 to F-14. Removed hatch on F-15.
RU and ran 6 mT tugger for moving riser landing guide funnel. Hooked on tugger wire to master links on funnel using ROV.

Lifted and moved riser landing guide funnel from F-3 to F-14. Removed debris cap from F-14 and placed on sea bed. Landed and oriented upper guiding skirt on funnel in east direction. Disconnected ROV hooks on master links.

Meanwhile removed hatches, built scaffolding/barriers around deck openings and prepared equipment for installing tensioner ring assembly in WH module.
Held tool box talk for running production riser with involved personnel.

Lifted TBC/stress joint from cantiliver until handling sub was latched into TDS. Unhooked uppermost sling and lifted TBC/stress joint with TDS until it was hanging vertically above rotary.

Meanwhile installed VX-ring using ROV, built scaffolding/barriers around deck openings and prepared equipment for installing tensioner ring assembly in WH module.

Lowered TBC/stress joint through rotary. Extended riser spider dogs and installed stop bolts in PR holes #3. Hung off stress joint in riser spider. Alligned TBC ROV panels and checked TBC connector for damage.
Lifted 1st double with dual lift on block and deckcrane.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: POOH with HPDR. Moved riser landing guide funnel from F-3 to F-14. Ran TBC and function tested same. Installed guide wires. Continued RIH with PR to 2nd double.

activities.remarks: Made up flanged connection according to Vetco/Bandak procedure. Installed fairring on coupling. Ran in and placed TBC connector in level with Weather deck deck. Prepared guidewires in slot F-13 and F-15.

Placed TBC in in level with Weatherdeck. Function tested TBC according to Vetco instruction. Installed dummy stabs. Oriented lock/unlock panel to 45 deg starboard aft. Attached ROV hooks to guide slings. Hauled guidewires with ROV hooks through Centralizer deck, ran to sealevel. Landed 1 st double in riser spider. Ran guidewires individually to 20 m above seabed.

Removed handling tool. Lifted 2nd double to drillfloor with dual lift on block and deck crane. Started MU up flanged connection according to Vetco/Bandak procedure. 

Meanwhile installed guidewires using ROV.

MU up flanged connection on 2nd double according to Vetco/Bandak procedure. Continued removing handling tools,  lifting doubles to drillfloor with dual lift on block and deck crane, MU up flanged connections according to Vetco/Bandak procedure and tested flanges to 3000 psi / 5 min,   from 66 to 118 m. Could not MU DP due to PRS not operational.

Tested deluge system from 10:30 to 10:45 hr.
Repaired sheared bolts on PRS track on drill floor.

Landed riser on tension joint land off plate in riser spider. MU DP connection to handling sub using TopDrive and manual rig tongs.Lifted PR string and lowered it down to top of riser landing guide funnel (RLGF). Removed hole cover from RLGF and oriented TBC ROV panels. Hook load 97 mT. Continued lowering PR until TBC was 10 cm above VGX gasket.

Re-arranged lifting slings on RLGF and put tension on wires. Attempted to unlock guide funnel hinge using ROV. No sucess. Fetched crow bar from surface and attempted to bend guide funnel hinge. No sucess. Fetched cutting device from surface and cut guide funnel hinge with tension on RLGF wire slings. RLGF came free. Lowered PR a fraction. Attempted to move RLGF but found that riser weight had landed off on funnel edge. PU PR a fraction and moved landing guide funnel to seabed aft of F-10/F-15. Alligned TBC ROV panel, landed TBC and applied 15 mT.

Pumped baseoil to cmt unit and verified line-up to F-12. Performed line test 30 /150 bar 5/10 min against F-12 wing valve. Pumped 8.5 m3 baseoil to pressure up and equalized above DHSV. Opened F-12 DHSV at 93 bar. Displaced cmt unit and kill line to SW.

Launched hotstab on mini-reel hose down to seabed, attached to guidewire. Removed dummy hot stab and installed hydraulic hot stab into receptacle at top of TBC using ROV.

Production started at 23:25.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: Continued RIH with PR. Landed riser and removed riser landing guiding funnel. Started production. Locked TBC and pressure tested PR against RTTS to 100 bar / 10 min.

activities.remarks:
Sat TBC ROV panel A in "primary unlock" 2-1-1 and RIH with PR another 10-15 cm. Sat TBC ROV panel A in "primary lock" 2-1-2. Sat down 15 mT on PR. Pressured up through TBC port A to 3000 psi and observed silver band alignement of indicator rods above TBC top cap. Silver band was completely aligned. Sat TBC ROV panel A in "parked position".

Performed 10 mT overpull test to 107 mT to confirmed that TBC was locked. Ok. Sat TBC ROV panel B in "lower dog flush" x-1-1 and removed dummy hot-stab to be able to observe possible leak.
Lined up to pressure test PR against RTTS plug from cmt unit using SW. Performed line test to 120 bar/5 min. Ok.
Filled riser with SW using cmt unit.

Performed pressure test of PR aginst RTTS plug/14" csg shoe.
20 bar / 10 min 0.6 bar drop 
50 bar / 10 min 0.6 bar drop
60 bar / 10 min 0.8 bar drop
70 bar 7 10 min 0.8 bar drop
80 bar / 10 min 0.8 bar drop
90 bar / 10 min 0.9 bar drop
100 bar / 10 min 1.3 bar drop
110 bar / 10 min 4.0 bar drop. 725 ltrs pumped and 560 ltrs bled back. No leak observed by ROV.

Pull hot stab out of TBC ROV panel A and insert it into TBC ROV panel B. Flushed upper port on hot stab "B" with corrosion inhibitor.

Meanwhile started to prepare tensioner system in WH module.

Sat TBC ROV panel B in "upper piston flush" 1-x-x and continued flushing with corrosion inhibitor. Sat TBC ROV panel B in "parking position" and installed dummy stab. Released and retrieved guide wires for PR.

Meanwhile prepared tensioner system in WH module.

Installed centralizers, boat collision stool and tensioner ring in WH module.

Meanwhile lowered PR cutting equipment and valve and equipment for multibowl down to tensioner deck. Changed out encoder on AFT PRS and worked on BOP annular.
Held time-out for safety to discuss recent events.

Continued installing tensioner ring in WH module.

Meanwhile worked on BOP annular.

Held tool box meeting and RU to install hatches on weather deck. Flushed lines from cmt unit to rig floor with baseoil. 
Meanwhile closed down production on F-12. Production down at 19:55 hr.
Installed hatch on F-13.

Waited on production to confirme valve status.

Meanwhile installed hatch on F-15.
Verified line up to F-12. Bled off pressure to choke manifold. Performed line test to 120 bar/5 min.
Waited for production to verify that DHSV was open and bled off pressure to choke manifold.

Continued installing tensioner ring and tension cylinders in WH module. Production up at 22:00 hr.

Meanwhile bolted down hatches F-13 and F-15 on weather deck.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: Retrieved guide wires for PR. Installed centralizers, boat collision stool, tensioner ring and tension cylinders in WH module. Shut down production on F-12 and installed hatches on F-13 and F-15. Transfered weight from TDS to tensioner system. Measured cutting hight on PR and RU cutting tool. Started cutting PR 1414 mm above tensioner deck.

activities.remarks:
Continued installing tension cylinders in WH module. Installed protector guide on tensioner deck.

Meanwhile bolted up hatches F-13 and F-15 on weather deck.
Checked level and opened valves on nitrogen system. Transfered weight from TDS to tensioner system.  Had 90 bar on all cylinders and 70.5 mT on TDS (neutral) when operation was finished.

Measured cutting hight on PR to 1414 mm above tensioner deck and marked riser. Verified measurement B on machined tectyl coated area. Adjusted weight in TDS to 72,3 mT. RU and leveled cutting tool. Installed auto-feed system.
Started cutting PR production riser using auto-feed and 8-12 rpm.
Completed cutting the PR. Pulled out landing string with top part of Tension Joint. Broke connection between DP and Handling Tool. L/D Top part of Tension Joint.

Installed Inflatable Ball inside PR, as a debris barrier for metal swarf during bevelling. Bevelled the PR. 

Simultaneously worked on the BOP.
Retrieved the cutting gear to the rig floor and rigged down same.
Held tool box talk and rigged down the 5½" handling equipment, slings and the Spider. Moved the Spider out from the rig floor.
Installed outer ring and master bushing and rigged up 5½" handling equipment.
Held tool box talk and broke out the riser RT and LO same.
Held tool box talk prior to install the Multibowl. Had production to shut down the water inject. on F4.

M/U the Multibowl and ran in and installed same as per Vetco procedure.
Pressure tested to 35 bar to ensure BT seals intack. Energized plastic in upper and lower BT seals, and pressure tested same to 3000 psi (207 bar) 10 min.
Retrieved the Multibowl RT and LO same.
Installed valves on the Multibowl.
Held time out for safety.
Prepared for running BOP riser jnt. and picked up same. Build scaffolding around the Multibowl.
Ran in and installed the BOP riser jnt. and torqued up same. PU 2.5 tons to ensure locking segment were locked.
Retrieved slings for running BOP riser jnt. Installed outer ring and master bushing. Installed hatch cover. Started water injection on F4 at 23:55 hours.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: Cut the PR and bevelled same. Installed the Multibowl and valves. Installed BOP riser jnt. Built scaffolding to get access to BOP riser jnt connection. Changed wash pipe.

activities.remarks: Cleared and cleaned rig floor.
Held tool box talk prior to rig up and change wash pipe. Rigged up for changing out the wash pipe.

Built scaffolding in the Moon Pool to get access to the BOP riser jnt connection. Flushed lines from cmt. to rig floor prior to perform BOP test. 

Simultaneously worked on the BOP.

Changed out wash pipe.

 Meanwhile pressure tested the BOP to 20/345 bars for 5/10 min.
Completed changing of the wash pipe.

Rigged up and pressure tested the wash pipe and the IBOP 20/345 bars 5/10 mins.

Meanwhile pressure test the BOP to 20/345 bars for 5/10 min.

Rigged down equipment for testing of the wash pipe and IBOP. Installed slings for handling the Diverter.

Meanwhile checked torque on bolts on annular.

Lined up and positioned test joint for testing of annular. Tested annular to 20/345 bar 5/10 mins.

Meanwhile checked equipment prior to picking up HWDP. Changed dies in flush joint elevators. Held tool box prior to handling of HWDP. Attempted to handle HWDP, not able to open fingers on PDM head.

Held tool box talk prior to nippling of the BOP and Diverter. Nippled down the BOP NT2 connector.

Meanwhile Changed dies in TDS pipe handler.
Picked up the Diverter and landed on the rig floor. Moved the BOP into to well centre and nippled up same.
Pulled master bushing and ran slick jnt into the BOP.
Held tool box talk and installed the Diverter and made up the NT2 connector.
Cleared and cleaned rig floor.
Held tool box talk and installed hang off wires on TDS.
Prepared handling equipment for slip and cut of drill line.
Held tool box talk prior to slip and cut drill line.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: Tested the Wash pipe IBOP to 20/345 bars 5/10 mins. Nippled up BOP and Diverter and pressure tested same to 20/345 bars 5/10 mins. Performed slip and cut of drill line.

activities.remarks: Perform slip and cut of drill line.
Continued slip and cut of drill line.
Calibrated top drive.
Held tool box talk prior to install test plug in surface well for testing of BOP riser connection.
Made up test plug and RIH and landed off in surface well head.
Held tool box talk and filled riser to SW and tested BOP connection to 35/345 bars 5/10mins.
POOH with test plug.
Held tool box talk and broke out test plug and made up wear bushing RT with Bowl Protector.
RIH and set Bowl Protector as per Vetco procedure. POOH and laid out Bowl Protector RT.
Held tool box talk prior to handling HWDP.
Checked dies in PRS, PDM and handling equipment prior to pick up HWDP. Unable to handle HWDP with PDM.
Trouble shooted the PDM, found that PDM had to be re-programmed for handling HWDP.
RIH with Annulus Insert RT, while picking up dedicated HWDP landing string from cantilever. Found incompatible tool jnts. with 3mm gab.
POOH and laid out 3 jnt incompatible tool jnts. Picked up and meassured 3 new jnts.
Continued RIH with Annulus Insert RT, on dedicated HWDP landing string to 113m.

Made up Landing String to TDS. RIH and tagged top of Annulus Insert,
with max. 2 ton. Engaged the J-slot and took 1 ton overpull. Slacked off to neutral string weight. Rotated to the left approx 6 turns, while keeping neutral weight to retrieve Annulus Insert.
POOH and laid out RRT and Annulus Insert. As POOH with the Annulus Insert passed subsea well head very carefully and surface well head wear bushing very slowly due to small clearances.
Made up Bull nose jet sub and RIH from surface to 140m.
Lined up and washed subsea well reciprocating the pipe, pumped 40m³ SW, 10m³ Hi-vis and displaced  riser to 1.03 sg Treated Seawater.
POOH and L/D Bullnose sub.
Made up Primary Bowl Protector RRT on DP. RIH and retrieved Bowl Protector, POOH and laid out Bowl Protector.
Held tool box talk and made up Spear assy. using rig-tongs. Racked back Spear assy. in derrick.
Cleared and cleaned rig floor.
Held tool box talk and commenced rig up casing handling equipment and casing tong.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: Tested BOP connection to 35/345 bars 5/10mins. Washed subsea well head. Rigged up casing handling equipment. RIH with 10 3/4" Tie-back adapter on 10 3/4" casing and made up 10 3/4" surface casing hanger assembly.

activities.remarks: Continued rigging up casing handling equipment and casing tong.
Held tool box talk prior to RIH with 10 3/4" casing.
Picked up and RIH 10 3/4" Tie-back adapter on 10 3/4" casing from surface to 108m.
Picked up pre-packed 10 3/4" surface casing hanger assembly with Adjustment Sub and casing hanger Handling tool. Made up assembly with low stick-up.
Held tool box talk and released Casing Hanger RT with 10 right hand turns.
Laid out 10 3/4" surface casing hanger handling sub. Changed surface handling equipment to DP.
Made up premade spear stand from derrick and stabbed into 10 3/4" casing.
Held tool box talk and ran in with 10 3/4" surface casing hanger from 119m to 140m. Tagged subsea tie back well head. Meanwhile drained riser.

Rotated with 3 rpm with torque limit set at 2500 Nm. Observed stall out and Spear released. Engaged Spear again with 12 MT overpull and 2 rpm. Increased torque incrementally in 500 Nm stages. Achieved max torque of 8500 Nm prior to Spear released. Re-engaged with 13 MT overpull and 4 rpm and applied torque. Observed 10,800 Nm make up before spear released.
Took 30 MT overpull, observed 0.5 inch stretch.
Released Spear and POOH to surface. Broke off TDS and racked stand back.
Held tool box talk and rigged down Odfjell casing tong.
Broke off and laid out Spear.
Held tool box talk and RIH with one stand of 5½" DP. P/U the 5½" pre-made stand with Adjustment Sub Setting Tool, and made up same.

RIH with Adjustment Sub Setting Tool to 28,6 m. and engaged Adjustment Sub. Applied 140 bar pressure inside tool. Found that tool was engaged in casing coupling just below latch profile, max OP 2 tons. Bled off pressure and lowered tool down approx. 2 cm. Rotated to the right while PU slowly to engage torque slots in adjustment sub. Rotated and landed surface hanger with 11 MT. Took 30 MT overpull. Attempted to release the Adjustment Sub Setting Tool.

Attempted to come up with string and took overpull. Worked string down and rotated 1½ turns. Attempted to pull up and took overpull. Went back down and applied 140 bars to the string, bleed off the pressure and went down, had 10 MT drag going down. Attempted to pull out took overpull immediately. Tool stuck in casing connection just below setting tool latch profile.

Laid out joint #16 and replaced with joint #21 to put stinger no-go 0,35 m above PBR. Prepared for picking up tubing hanger.
Picked up and made up 13 5/8" TH with handling tool. Cut, stripped and prepared control lines for pulling through TH.
Installed fittings on control lines and pulled control lines through TH. Made up fittings on control lines on bottom/top of TH. Unable to get good test on TH penetration fittings.

Found leakage across fittings for DHSV. Made several attempts to fix fitting with locktite - negative. Took out DHSV control line. Removed fittings and installed new ones. Applied lock tite to fitting threads.
Allowed locktite thread compound to harden prior to pressure test.
Pressure tested TH fittings to 35 / 345 bar 5 / 10 min - ok.
Installed C-plate. Landed TH in C-plate.
Broke off TH handling tool and laid down same.
Wrapped control lines around tubing hanger neck. Installed communication collar and teminated 3 ea hydraulic lines in same. Changed to 5 1/2" inserts in BX elevator.

Picked up TH landing stand. Made up THRT to TH with 9 counterclockwise turns using chain tongs. Made up control lines for chemical injection, ASV and DHSV to THRT. Pressure tested DHSV/ASV control lines. Made up control lines for THRT activation.

Removed C-plate and masterbushing. Ran TH/THRT through rotary. Installed masterbushing. Positioned stinger at 2613 m MD approx 3 m above PBR at 2615,4 m. Made up cement hose to side entry on landing string. Marked tubing with TH landing point.
Lined up for pumping baseoil down tubing taking returns to pits. Checked out alarm on mud pump liner spray.
Pumped baseoil in to tubing at 200 lpm to obtain underbalance in well.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: Terminated control lines in tubing hanger. Made up THRT / landing string. Displaced 10 m3 baseoil in to tubing. RIH and landed TH at 20,45 m MD. Tested TH. Performed low pressure tests. Set production packer and tested tubing. Inflow tested DHSV.

activities.remarks: Pumped baseoil in to tubing at 200 lpm to obtain underbalance in well. Pressure increased from 0,5 bar to 6,9 bar during displacement. Pumped a total of 10 m3. Took up/down weight 170/150 MT.

Ran in and attempted to land TH in wellhead. Unable to enter PBR at 2615,4 m MD. Picked up and attempted several (12) times to enter PBR - negative. Set down max 7 MT. At last attempt, observed that string moved incrementallly (2-3 cm) for each time weight was set down. Discussed situation - meanwhile maintained ~5 MT downweight. Observed sudden drop in applied weight - stinger free to move downwards. Drained riser. Landed tubing hanger at correct datum mark. Observed pressure buliding up from 6 bar to 11 bar indicating sealstem travel.

Tested tubing hanger through port#1 and #2 in multibowl, 35 bar / 5 min - ok. Pressured up TH function line to enagage tubing hanger lock ring. Performed overpull test to 185 MT, i.e. 15 MT above last upweight. Lined up cement unit and performed line test against closed lo-torque valve on landing stand, 345 bar / 5 min - ok.
Pressure tested tubing/sealstem to 50 bar / 5 min - ok. Volume pumped 149 liter.
Closed DHSV and bled off pressure above to ~3 bar. Bled back 30 liter. Held inflow test for 10 min - ok. Equalized across DHSV and opened same. Volume pumped 50 liter.

Pressured up to 345 bar at 120 lpm to set production packer and test tubing. Held test for 25 min - improving trend last 15 min (5 min 1,3 bar => 5 min 0,7 bar => 5 min 0,5 bar) - ok. Pumped a total of 1088 liter. Packer installed at 2598 mMDRT.

Bled down tubing pressure to 280 bar, bled back volume 180 liter. Closed DHSV and bled off pressure above to 156 bar, bled back volume 90 liter. Not able to adjust the choke to the intended 210 bar. Inflow tested DHSV to 125 bar differential. Held test for 15 min - increased 0,2 bar last 5 min with improving trend - ok.

Bled down tubing pressure from 156 bar to 10 bar to put 270 bar differential across the DHSV. Bled back 100 liter. Held inflow test for 30 min - test improving by time, last 5 min 0,02 bar increase. Equalised pressure (280 bar) accross DHSV and opened same. Pumped 190 liter. Bled back pressure on tubing to line up for pressure testing annulus. Total bled back volume 940 liter.
Lined up to maintain pressure on string while pressuring up tubng x casing annulus. Rigged down kill hose from F-12 and attached to hose on F-14 A-annulus. Pressured up to 100 bar on tubing.
Lined up cement unit and performed line test against closed lo-torque on A-annulus, 35/345 bar 5/10 min - ok.

Pressured up to 330 bar on A-annulus to set FLX packer and test production packer from above. maintained pressrue on tubing >100 bar. Held pressure for 15 min / 0,2 bar drop - ok. Total volume pumped 1107 liter. Vented B-annulus while performing test.

Bled down pressure on A-annulus to 270 bar, bled back 60 liters. Closed ASV and bled off pressure above to 200 bar to put 70 bar differential across ASV, bled back 160 liters. Inflow tested ASV for 15 mins - ok.
Bled down pressure above ASV to 10 bar to put 260 bar differential across ASV, bled back 160 liters. Maintained ~90 bar in tubing. Inflow tested ASV for 30 mins - ok.
Equlized accross ASV by pressuring up on A-annulus to 270 bar, pumped 220 liters. Bled off annulus pressure to zero. Bled off pressure on tubing from 90 bar to zero.
Disconnected cement hose from cement manifold. Released THRT by 9 clokwise turn and picked up 1 m. Secured cement hose on landing string.
Displaced landing string and riser to seawater pumping 15 m3 at 2000 lpm. Rigged down cement line. POOH with THRT and detached control lines from same.
Broke THRT from landing string. Broke landing string and laid down 2 x pup and 1 full joint.
Rig down and removed tubing running equipment, sheaves and reels from drillfloor.
Made up BPV setting tool. RIH with BPV and set same at 20,4 m MD according to Vetco instructions. POOH with BPV setting tool and laid down same.
RIH with 5 1/2" DP stand to 19,5 m MD. Attached air hose fitting to 1502 hub on standpipe. Displaced riser to air.
Held handover meeitng / toolbox prior to nippling down diverter, BOP and riser.
Laid out tubing single and 2 x pups form landing string. Undid nuts on slick joint.
Removed master bushing and outer ring from rotary.
Changed to 5" inserts in elevator to accommodate conductor housing pulling tool. Released mechanical seals on overshot.
Installed 10" split inserts in diverter.  Picked up diverter release tool. Not able to engage and release diverter.
Attempted several times to engage and release diverter - negative. Laid down diverter release tool.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: Tested A-annulus and set FLX packer. Inflow tested ASV. Released THRT, pulled and broke landing string. Set BPV. Nippled down diverter and BOP. Prepared to pull BOP riser.

activities.remarks: Removed elevator and attached slings to bails. Pulled diverter using slings and set back same.
Pulled overshot joint using slings. Installed outer ring and masterbushing.
Dismanteled BOP tension cylinder and pulled aside. Racked back overshot joint. Cleared drillfloor for pulling BOP riser joint.
Disconnected NT-2 on BOP. Installed cradle in HTS. Installed slings for pulling riser BOP riser joint.
Skidded BOP to stb storage. Attached 2 ea 10 MT slings to BOP riser joint padeyes.
Disconnected BOP riser joint NT-2 on wellhead. Removed scaffolding on weather deck.
Removed scaffloding on weather deck. Removed split hatches in weather deck. Removed masterbushing. Confirmed well F-4 shut in with no pressure. Picked up riser and drained out seawater inside.
Held toolbox talk prior to pulling riser.
Pulled BOP riser through wellhead moudule, moonpool and rotary. Laid out riser on HTS cradle.
Installed and secured hatch on weather deck. Installed dart in BPV.

Removed communication collar and unwrapped control lines as required. Fitted graphoil seals and fed control lines through dedicated ports in wellhead. Made up external fittings on control lines to energize graphoil seals. Installed VG137 seal on multibowl and VG63 seal on top of tubing hanger. Filled void with hydraulic oil. Meanwhile cleaned and tidied wellhead and prepared for lifting down XMT spool.

Transferred and installed XMT spool on wellhead according to Vetco instructions. Made up NT-2 connector. Energized BT seal pumping plastic sealant through port #7/#8 (up to 5000 psi). Tested VG63 seal by applying 500 psi through port #9/#10. Tested TH void through test port #5/#6 to 345 bar / 15 min - ok.

Meanwhile attached slings onto TDS bails for lifting XMT.
Picked up XMT with port overhead crane in moonpool and landed XMT on Weatherdeck. Transferred XMT to slings from drillfloor. Backed up lift sideways using 6 T moonpool tugger.
Removed F-9 hatch and beam for passing through XMT.
Lifted XMT though weather deck and placed onto spool pice on XMT deck. Orientated tree according to instructions from Vecto/production dept. Made up Graylock connection.

Installed hatches on weatherdeck. Pressure tested seal ring between spool and XMT to 35 bar / 10 min through test ports #3 and #4. Installed teflon seal rings and made up exit blocks for hydraulic lines.

Installed exit block for DHPG control ine. Had problems with broken allen bolt, installed new bolt. Tested exit block to 10000 psi according to WD procedure - not able to get good test. Discussed situation - test in SH procedure specified 5000 psi test. Re-tested exit block to 5000 psi, but still not able to get good test. Broke off exit block and removed excess paint from WH and exit block. Polished exit block seal surface. Installed exit block, hooked up Vetco pump with recorder and tested exit block to 500/5000 psi 5/10 min -ok. 

Meanwhile pulled and laid down diverter.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: Nippled down BOP riser. Removed comm collar, pulled control lines through WH and tested pentrations. Installed and tested XMT spool. Installed and tested XMT connection. Made up and tested WH exit blocks. Made up and tested DHPG outlet - negative. Installed and made up flow spool on XMT. Hooked up coflex production hose to hub in wellhead module.

activities.remarks:
Spliced DHPG cable. Made up DHPG wellhead outlet to exit block according to WD procedure. Pressure tested wellhead outlet -  negative. Observed leakage around threads between wellhead outlet and exit block. Dismanteled wellhead outlet and found damage on primary metal seal around threads. Discussed situation. Decided to go ahead with XMT hook up activities.

Meanwhile serviced TDS.
Installed flow spool on XMT with tugger support from drillfloor according to instructions from production.

Made up XMT flow spool with hy-torq kit. Worked to hook up coflex hose to wellhead module production hub. Used slings, chainhoists and eagle clamps as required to support/jack coflex hose. 

Meanwhile hung off travelling block for 6 month maintenance of crown block.
Hooked up coflex hose to hub in wellhead module. Made up clamp with Hy-torq kit.
Removed hatches and transferred flowline support bracket to XMT deck. Installed hatches

Removed DHPG wellhead outlet. Cut and reterminated DHPG conductor. Replaced seals and re-installed DHPG wellhead outlet according to WD procedure. Tested wellhead outlet through exit block to 345 bar / 10 min - ok. Hooked up DHPG to wellhead junction box. Found that flow spool on XMT had wrong allignement.
Broke bolts on flowline spool. Re-alligned flowline spool.
Installed flowline hub support bracket on XMT. Found that it was the wrong bracket, even though it was marked F-14.
Reverted to testing hydraulic control lines. Hooked up BOT pump. Tested DHSV line and exit block to 570 bar / 15 min - ok. Tested ASV line and exit block to 570 bar / 15 min - ok.
Removed chain hoists and slings from flowlines and repalced with 5 MT chainhoists and slings.
Removed wellhead bracket from XMT and put on weatherdeck. Meanwhile cut bolt holes in F-14 support bracket in mechanical workshop.
Rigged chainblocks and slings in moonpool for supporting tugger when pulling in coflex flowline Made up bolts on flow spool with Hy-torq kit.

Pulled/jacked coflex flowline hose using chain hoists, slings and tugger from drillfloor. Brought modified support bracket to XMT deck. Installled support bracket on XMT.

Meanwhile serviced fwd PRS.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: Hooked up coflex hose to production hub in wellhead. Tested DHPG outlet. Installed flowline support bracket - wrong type. Tested DHSV/ASV lines/exit blocks. Modified and made up correct flowline support bracket. Pulled in and made up coflex hose to XMT. Attempted to fit support bracket shoe/clamp - too narrow gap to fit. Hooked up hose to XMT and performed body test to 345 bar / 10 min. Lined up for filling coflex hose.

activities.remarks: Jacked coflex flowline hub in place and made up graylock clamp with handtools.

Made up bolts on graylock clamp with Hy-torq kit. Attmepted to fit support bracket shoe/clamp - observed to narrow angle/gap between support bracket and shoe/clamp. Discussed situation- decided to continue operation as modification of the shoe/clamp would be needed. Suspended flowline in 2 ea 5 MT slings/chainhoists. Removed tugger from flowline. Removed kill line on F-12 and moved to F-14. Flushed packer fluid from cement unit and displaced line to drillwater. Pulled hydraulic line from well control panel to XMT deck. Installed hatches and cover.

Meanwhile serviced TDS and drawworks.

Held toolbox talk prior to XMT bodytest and filling coflex flowline. Lined up cement unit. Performed line test against closed kill wing valve 30/345 bar 5 /10 min - ok. Opened kill wing valve, hydraulic master valve and manual master valve. Vented flowline on flow spool. Performed body test of XMT to 30/345 bar 5/10 min - ok. Lined up for filling coflex flowline from cement unit.
Lined up for filling coflex flowline. Filled coflex flowline with drillwater pumping from cement unit via KWV and HWV on XMT.
Held handover meeting / toolbox. Prepared for pulling dart and BPV.
Made up BPV retrieval rod. Pulled BPV and dart.
Transferred Well Dynamics pump to wellhead. Ran DHSV control hose from hydraulic panel in moonpool.

Performed line test agains KWV to 30 bar / 5 min - ok. Attempted to test coflex flowline to 99 bar. Pressured up on cement unit. Walked lines and observed leakage in production manifold system.

Meanwhile prepared for running WL.

Attached hydrualic control hoses from well control panel to DHSV exit block and HMV actuator. Made up WD chemical injection manifold on wellhead. Re-arranged WD test pump and hooked up to checmical injection mainfold. Opened KWV and HMV from local control panel.

Meanwhile prepared for running WL.

Pressured up tubing to 35 bar and opened DHSV. Continued to pressure up on tubing to 220 bar / (750 liters). Closed LMV and bled off pressure above to 5 bar. Observed inflow test for 10 min - ok. Pressured up chemical injection line while maintaining pressure on tubing - held test for 10 min -  ok. Equalize across LMV and opened same.

Meanwhile prepared for running WL.
Closed HMV and bled off pressure above to 5 bar. Inflow tested HMV for 10 min - ok.

Bled of tubing pressure while maintaining pressure on chemical injection line. Observed rupture disc shearing at 70 bar tubing pressure. Chemical injection line pressure stabilized at ~50 bar. Pressured up on tubing to 100 bar to confirm checmical injection check valve holding - ok.
Closed KWV, SHV and HMV. Rigged down testing equipment.
Installed XMT cap.

Commissioned XMT.

Meanwhile prepared for running WL : 
-Re-arranged toolcatcher
-Bulit grease injection
-Built cable head
-Checked and tested equipment

daily_reports.remarks_combined: Filled coflex hose. Retieved BPV/dart. Made up chemical injection manifold to wellhead. Tested chemical injection line. Inflow tested LMV and HMV. Commissioned XMT. Meanwhile prepared for WL operations and performed rig maintenance.

activities.remarks:
Comissioned XMT. Tested coflex hose 100 bar / 15 min - test approved by production.

Meanwhile prepared for running WL :
-Changed IBOP on TDS
-Performed service on drawwork
-Cleaned and tidied drillfloor
-Removed support bracket from flowline for modifications
-Checked and tested equipment
-Made up lubricator sections on cantilever
-Spotted grease injection skid and well control skid on drillfloor

Commissioned XMT.

Meanwhile :
-Dismantled IBOPs
-Maintenance on diverter
-Mounted and commissioned manrider on drillfloor
-Cleaned lower shakers
-Performed derrick inspection

Commissioned XMT.

Meanwhile :
-Installed WL riser spool / x-over on XMT.
-Installed WL BOP's
-Fitted hole cover around WL riser spool on weatherdeck

Commissioned XMT.

Meanwhile :
-Mounted IBOPs
-Prepared for running WL
-Cleaned in drilling areas

daily_reports.remarks_combined: Commissioned XMT. Meanwhile prepared for running WL and performed rig maintenance.

activities.remarks:
Commissioned XMT.

Meanwhile :
-Tested IBOP.s to 30345 bar 5/10 min - ok
-Spotted WL BOP control unit
-Built sacffolding around WL BOPs in moonpool
-Hooked up and functioned WL BOPs
-Ran WL riser and connected to WL BOPs
-Tested/checked WL logging tools and WL tractor
-Rigged lo-torques and check valve on F-14 XMT

Commissioned XMT.

Meanwhile :
-Cleaned drillfloor
-Maintenance on diverter
-Tidied in moonpool and wellhead module
-Cleaned sackstore, pumproom and lower shakers
-Rigged slings for WL sheaves

daily_reports.remarks_combined: Commissioned XMT. Performed line test. Hooked up local control on XMT.

activities.remarks:
Commissioned XMT.

Meanwhile :
-Cleaned drillfloor
-Maintenance on diverter
Held toolbox talk prior to pressure testing WL rig up.
Lined up cement unit. Performed line test against KWV on XMT 30/345 bar 5/10 min - ok. Bled off pressure in line to cement unit. Bled off pressure in XMT to closed drain.

Hooked up local control on XMT. Removed hydraulic tube from HMV and drained hydraulic fluid. Hooked up and tested DHSV control hose to hose on XMT, tested to 520 bar / 10 min - ok. Hooked up HMV control hose and valve block. Had problems with leaking fitting on instrument valve block on HMV control hose. Reterminated fitting and tested hose 207 bar / 15 min - ok.
Leak tested rig up to rig floor to 30/185 bar 5/10 min using cmt pump and packer fluid. Ok. Bled off pressure to zero. Meanwhile held tool box talk for PU WL lubricator.

Lifted in pre-made lubricator assembly from cantiliver to rig floor using crane and conveyer belt. Lifted lubricator vertically using T-bar in TDS and lifting slings. RU Welltech WL-tractor assembly in lower riser and GR-CCL, shock absorber and cable head in upper riser. MU entire toolstring and lifted into toolcatcher. MU lubricator to lower riser.
Opened SV (43 turns) and filled riser and lubricator with packer fluid using cmt pump. Meanwhile hoisted down bracket from XMT
Leak tested rig up to 30/185 bar 5/10 min using cmt pump and packer fluid. Ok.
Drained riser and flushed lines from cmt unit to closed drain with MEG.
Worked to free WL toolstring from toolcatcher.

Lowered orientating weight and 30 ft gun section into lower riser section and hung off in C-plate. Filled riser with 200 ltrs of Ramex. Connected and armed perforating guns according to Schlumberger procedure.
Filled riser/lubricator with 180 ltrs of 100% MEG using cmt unit. Leak tested in-situ sub to 30/185 bar 5/10 min using Seawell pumpe and 100% MEG. Ok.
Open HMV and SV (43 turns). Equalized and opened DHSV. RIH with BHA #1 to perforate interval #1 from surface to 250 m. Powered up logging unit with guns 70 m below seabed.

RIH with BHA #1 from 250 to 3081,5 m. PU 50 m every 500 m due to new cable. Ran carefully through DHSV and pulled back up to confirm that it was fully open. Up weigh 480kg / hanging weight 466 kg at 493 m MDRT. Weights while RIH was according to tension simulations. Correlated and adjusted depth by 1 m before starting tractor.
Powered up WL tractor and continued RIH with BHA #1 to perforate interval #1 from 3081,5 to 3400 m. Running speed 12 m/min.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: Leak test rig up 30/185 bar 5/10 min. RIH with perforation run#1 on WL to 3400 m. Correlated to shooting depth. Trouble shoot Schlumberger communication problem with downhole tools.

activities.remarks: Performed correlation log from 3400 m to 3200 m. Powered up WL tractor and ran back down to 3400 m. Schlumberger tools would not operate properly.
Trouble shoot power problem with downhole tools. Could not operate GR and switches, but were able to operate WL tractor. Attempted to locate error in surface system.
Continued to trouble shoot power problem with downhole tools. Could not operate GR and switches, but were able to operate WL tractor.
POOH with BHA #1 from 3400 m to 250 m. Powered down logging unit with guns 70 m below seabed. Closed DHSV, HMV and SV. Broke lubricator at in-situ sub and LD toolstring.

Continiued to trouble shoot power problem with toolstring. Had same problem with tools at surface. Found lower part of Welltec tractor drained for hydraulic oil. This may have affected tools below because the power situation in the toolstring was altered.

MU and installed BHA #2 to perforate #1 with back-up WL tractor, back-up GR tool (non-modified PGGT) and changed out Schlumberger switches. Unable to move toolstring due to power shut down on WL winch.
Made and installed new re-set handle for WL winch 380 V power supply. Trouble shoot problem with power supply.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: Continued to trouble shoot power problem with downhole tools. POOH and found hydraulic leak in WL tractor. Changed to back-up WL tractor, back-up shooting GR and changed out Schlumberger switches. Had problem with power supply for WL winch. MU BHA #2, filled riser/lubricator with Ramex/MEG and tested RU to 30/185 bar 5/10 min.

activities.remarks: Continued trouble shooting problem with power supply and found loose rele. Fastened rele and installed ex-cover on WL winch.

Lowered orientating weight and 30 ft gun section into lower riser section and hung off in C-plate. Filled riser with 200 ltrs of Ramex. Connected and armed perforating guns according to Schlumberger procedure.

Leak tested in-situ sub to 30/185 bar 5/10 min using Seawell pumpe and 100% MEG. Ok. Bled down grease pressure and filled riser/lubricator with 253 ltrs of 100% MEG using cmt unit. Unable to start RIH with BHA #1 due to power shut down on WL winch.
Trouble shoot problem with power supply on WL winch.
Open HMV and SV (43 turns). Equalized and opened DHSV. RIH with BHA #2 to perforate interval #1 from surface to 233 m. Powered up logging unit with guns 70 m below seabed.

RIH with BHA #2 from 233 to 3122 m. PU 50 m every 500 m due to new cable. Ran carefully through DHSV and pulled back up to confirm that it was fully open. Up weigh 480kg / hanging weight 466 kg at 493 m MDRT. Weights while RIH was according to tension simulations. Correlated and adjusted depth by 1 m before starting tractor.
Powered up WL tractor and continued RIH with BHA #2 to perforate interval #1 from 3122 to 3400 m. Running speed 12 m/min.
Performed correlation log from 3400 m to 3200 m using GR. Powered up WL tractor and ran back down to 3400 m.
Fired guns and perforated interval #1, from 3345 - 3354.2 m MDRT. Good indication of firing on DHPG.
Performed GR-CCL log from 3266 m to 2450 m MDRT.
POOH with BHA #1 from 2450 m to 250 m. Powered down logging unit with guns 70 m below seabed. Closed  HMV and SV.
Broke lubricator at in-situ sub and LD toolstring.

Opened KWV and HMV and attempted to bullehead baseoil using cmt unit. Stopped when pressure reached 100 bar at 80 lpm. 2.9 m3 baseoil pumped in total.

Meanwhile performed surface checks on Wellteck tractor and removed PGGT and chock absorber from toolstring.
Continued to perform surface checks on Welltech tractor. Lost contact with Schlumberger logging unit. Meanwhile held time-out for safety with drill crew with focus on the dropped object.
Schlumberger unit experienced power shut down and had to restart all systems.
Went through Schlumberger and Welltech checklists. Checked CCL and gun switches.
MU and installed BHA #3 to perforate interval #2.

Lowered orientating weight and 30 ft gun section into lower riser section and hung off in C-plate. Filled riser with 200 ltrs of Ramex. Connected and armed perforating guns according to Schlumberger procedure.
Leak tested in-situ sub to 30/150 bar 5/10 min using Seawell pumpe and 100% MEG. Ok.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: RIH with BHA #2 and perforate interval #1 on WL and tractor. Sucess. Rig up BHA #3. RIH and perforation interval #2 on WL and tractor.

activities.remarks: Bled down grease pressure and filled riser/lubricator with 250 ltrs of baseoil using cmt unit.
Open HMV and SV (43 turns). Equalized and opened DHSV. RIH with BHA #3 to perforate interval #2 from surface to 236 m. Powered up logging unit with guns 70 m below seabed.

RIH with BHA #3 from 236 to 3157 m. PU 50 m every 500 m due to new cable. Ran carefully through DHSV and pulled back up to confirm that it was fully open. Up weigh 480kg / hanging weight 465 kg at 493 m MDRT. Weights while RIH was according to tension simulations. Correlated and adjusted depth by 1 m before starting tractor.
Powered up WL tractor and continued RIH with BHA #3 to perforate interval #2 from 3157 to 3400 m. Running speed 12 m/min.

Performed correlation log from 3400 m to 2975 m using CCL. Powered up WL tractor and ran back down to 3400 m. Fired guns and perforated interval #2, from 3312 - 3321.2 m MDRT. Good indication of firing on DHPG.
POOH with BHA #3 from 3309.7 m to 250 m. Powered down logging unit with guns 70 m below seabed. Closed DHSV, HMV and SV.
Broke lubricator at in-situ sub and LD toolstring.

Opened KWV and HMV and bullheaded 17.2 m3 baseoil at 137 lpm / 99.6 bar using cmt unit.  Shut down pumps and observed pressure levelled out at 19 bar. Closed HMV. Bled down pressure above and inflow tested HMV. Ok.

Meanwhile performed torture test on logging cable. Cut off 60 m of cable and rebuilt cable head.
Continued building cable head and performed surface checks on Wellteck tractor.

Continued to perform surface checks on Welltech tractor. Went through Schlumberger and Welltech checklists.

Meanwhile installed test cap on lubricator. Opened KWV and pumped up to 19 bar above HMV using baseoil and cmt unit. Tested SV to 19 bar / 5 min. Opened HMV and read 19 bar WHP, 255 bar on DHPG. 

Displaced cmt line to 100% MEG at 50 lpm / 49 bar and got a final WHP of 20 bar. Closed HMV and bled off pressure to 5 bar above. Inflow tested HMV for 10 min. Ok. Bled off pressure above HMV and closed KWV and LT2.
Continued to go through Schlumberger and Welltech checklists. Checked CCL and gun switches.

Installed BHA #4 to perforate interval #3. Lowered orientating weight and 30 ft gun section into lower riser section and hung off in C-plate. Filled riser with 200 ltrs of Ramex. Connected and armed perforating guns according to Schlumberger procedure.
Leak tested in-situ sub to 30/150 bar 5/10 min using Seawell pumpe and 100% MEG. Ok. Bled down grease pressure and filled riser/lubricator with 250 ltrs of 100% MEG using cmt unit.

Performed time-out for safety with focus on dropped object. Pressured up to 20 bar and equalized pressure above HMV.Open HMV and SV (43 turns). Equalized and opened DHSV. RIH with BHA #4 to perforate interval #3 from surface to 235 m. Powered down logging unit with guns 70 m below seabed.

RIH with BHA #4 from 235 to 2500 m. PU 50 m every 500 m due to new cable. Ran carefully through DHSV and pulled back up to confirm that it was fully open. Weights while RIH was according to tension simulations. Schlumberger was unable to communicate with gun switches.
Trouble shoot problem with gun switches. POOH with BHA #4 from 2500 m to 1500 m and re-tried to communicate with the switches, because they worked at this depth while RIH. Negative.
POOH with BHA #4 from 1500 m to 250 m. Powered down logging unit with guns 70 m below seabed.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: POOH with BHA #3 and confirm perforation. Bullheaded 17.2 m3 of baseoil into well. Inflow tested HMV to 20-5 bar/10 min. RU BHA #4. RIH from surface to 2500 m to perforated interval #3 on WL. POOH and changed faulty gun switches. RU BHA #5 to perforated interval #3 on WL and tractor.

activities.remarks: Continued to POOH with BHA #4 from 250 m to 86 m. Unable to move toolstring due to power shut down on WL winch.
Electrican opened ex-panel and re-sat main switch.
Continued to POOH with BHA #4 from 86 m to 17 m. Unable to move toolstring due to power shut down on WL winch.
Electrican opened ex-panel and re-sat level sensor.

Continued to POOH with BHA #4 from 17 m to OOH. Closed SV and HMV. Inflow tested HMV to 20-5 bar/10 min. Ok. Bled off pressure. Held tool box meeting prior to LO guns and tractor. Cleaned rig floor due to slipping hazard. Broke lubricator at in-situ sub and hung off gun in riser.
Trouble shoot problem with gun switch and found faulty switch. Changed to back-up switches. Checked toolstring with tractor and switches installed.
LO guns and WL tractor. Checked WL tractor oil level.

Continued to perform checkes on WL tractor. Lifted WL tractor on to drill floor. 
Meanwhile cleaned drillfloor.

MU and installed BHA #5 to perforate interval #3. Lowered orientating weight and 30 ft gun section into lower riser section and hung off in C-plate. Drained riser and filled it with 200 ltrs of Ramex. Connected and armed perforating guns according to Schlumberger procedure. Leak tested in-situ sub to 30/150 bar 5/10 min using Seawell pumpe and 100% MEG. Ok.
Bled down grease pressure and filled riser/lubricator with 250 ltrs of 100% MEG using cmt unit. Pressured up to 20 bar and equalized above HMV.
Open HMV and SV (44 turns). 19.6 bar WHP and 255 bar on DHPG. RIH with BHA #5 to perforate interval #3 from surface to 235 m. Powered up logging unit with guns 70 m below seabed.
RIH with BHA #5 from 235 to 2500 m. PU 50 m every 500 m due to new cable. Ran carefully through DHSV and pulled back up to confirm that it was fully open.
RIH with BHA #5 from 2500 to 3180 m. PU 50 m every 500 m due to new cable. Weights while RIH was according to tension simulations. Correlated and adjusted depth before starting tractor.
Powered up WL tractor and continued RIH with BHA #5 to perforate interval #3 from 3180 to 3330 m. Running speed 11 m/min.

Performed correlation log from 3330 m to 2975 m using CCL. Had 10 min power shut-down on WL winch. Powered up WL tractor and ran back down to 3330 m. Fired guns and perforated interval #3, from 3287 - 3296.2 m MDRT. Good indication of firing on DHPG.
POOH with BHA #5 from 3250 m to 250 m. Powered down logging unit with guns 70 m below seabed.

Continued to POOH with BHA #5 from 250 m to OOH. Closed SV and HMV. Bled off XMT cross to 5.8 bar. Inflow tested HMV to 20-5.8 bar/10 min. Ok. Bled off pressure and drained riser. Cleaned rig floor due to slipping hazard.
Held tool box meeting prior to LO guns and tractor. Broke lubricator at in-situ sub and LD guns and toolstring.
Held tool box meeting before LD lubricator. LD lubricator on drill floor and removed tool catcher for Welltec cable head.
Inspected grease head and line wiper. Found kink on return hose and missing plug for grease head. Changed out grease return system on grease head.
Installed tool catcher for Schlumberger cable head.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: Perforated well with BHA #5, interval #3 on WL tractor. Changed tool catcher, rebuilt cable head and changed toolstring to BHA #6.

activities.remarks: Continued to install tool catcher for Schlumberger cable head.

Built new cable head on 7/16" cable for BHA #6. Checked CCL and toolstring. Prepared to RU lubricator.

Meanwhile trouble shoot bleed off valve on grease skid.
Held tool box meeting and PU lubricator to vertical position on rig floor. Observed incorrect installation of hoses on lubricator.
LD lubricator and re-arranged hoses.
PU lubricator to vertical position on rig floor. MU lubricator to lower riser.
Filled riser with 450 ltrs 100% MEG and pressure tested rig up to 30/185 bar 5/10 min. Ok. Broke lubricator at in-situ sub and checked CCL.

MU and installed BHA #6 to perforate interval #4. Lowered orientating weight, 20 ft gun section and 30 ft gun section into lower riser section and hung off in C-plate. Filled it with 185 ltrs of Ramex. Connected and armed perforating guns according to Schlumberger procedure. Leak tested in-situ sub to 30/150 bar 5/10 min using Seawell pump and 100% MEG. Ok.
Bled down grease pressure and filled riser/lubricator with 280 ltrs of 100% MEG using cmt unit. Pressured up to 20 bar and equalized above HMV. Drain hose on lubricator parted.
Re-united and fixed splize on drain hose on lubricator.
Open HMV and SV (44 turns). 22.2 bar WHP and 256 bar on DHPG. RIH with BHA #6 to perforate interval #4 from surface to 235 m. Powered up logging unit with guns 70 m below seabed.
RIH with BHA #6 from 235 to 3100 m. PU 50 m every 500 m due to new cable. Ran carefully through DHSV and pulled back up to confirm that it was fully open.
Performed correlation log from 3100 m to 2975 m using CCL. Ran back down to 3048 m. Fired guns and perforated interval #4, from 3044 - 3059.2 m MDRT. Good indication of firing on DHPG.
POOH with BHA #6 from 3250 m to 250 m. Powered down logging unit with guns 70 m below seabed.

Continued to POOH with BHA #5 from 250 m to OOH. WHP 33.7 bar and 263 bar on DHPG. Closed SV and HMV. Bled off XMT cross to 5.3 bar. Inflow tested HMV to 20-5.3 bar/10 min. Ok. Bled off pressure and flushed riser/lubricator with nitrogen. Cleaned rig floor due to slipping hazard.
Held tool box meeting prior to LO guns and tractor. Isolated gas detector on rig floor. Broke lubricator at in-situ sub and LD guns and toolstring. All shots fired.
Changed to backup head without rebuilding rope socket, due to ECRD weak point. Checked CCL and toolstring.
MU and installed BHA #7 to perforate interval #5. Lowered 30 ft gun section into lower riser section and hung off in C-plate.  Connected and armed perforating gun according to Schlumberger procedure.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: Perforate well with BHA #6, interval #4 on WL. Perforate well with BHA #7, interval #5 on WL.

activities.remarks: MU and installed BHA #7 to perforate interval #5. Lowered orientating weight and 20 ft gun section into lower riser section and hung off in C-plate. Connected and armed perforating guns according to Schlumberger procedure. Filled it with 180 ltrs of Ramex. Leak tested in-situ sub to 30/150 bar 5/10 min using Seawell pumpe and 100% MEG. Ok.
Bled down grease pressure and filled riser/lubricator with 270 ltrs of 100% MEG using cmt unit. Pressured up to 34 bar and equalized above HMV.
Open HMV and SV (44 turns). 42.3 bar WHP and 267 bar on DHPG. RIH with BHA #7 to perforate interval #5 from surface to 255 m. Powered up logging unit with guns 70 m below seabed.

RIH with BHA #7 from 255 to 3055 m. PU 50 m every 500 m due to new cable. Ran carefully through DHSV and pulled back up to confirm that it was fully open. Had 10 min power shut-down on WL winch. Had to use Schlumberger tension and depth system due to software problem in WL winch.

Performed correlation log from 3050 m to 2975 m using CCL. Ran back down to 3050 m. Adjusted brakes on WL winch. Fired guns and perforated interval #5, from 3021 - 3036.2 m MDRT. Good indications of firing.
POOH with BHA #7 from 3250 m to 250 m. Powered down logging unit with guns 70 m below seabed.

Continued to POOH with BHA #7 from 250 m to OOH. WHP 46.2 bar and 265 bar on DHPG. Closed SV and HMV. Bled off XMT cross to 5 bar. Inflow tested HMV to 46-5 bar/10 min. Ok. Bled off pressure and flushed riser/lubricator with nitrogen.
Held tool box meeting prior to LO guns. Broke lubricator at in-situ sub and LD guns and toolstring. All shots fired.
Changed to backup head without rebuilding rope socket, due to ECRD weak point. Checked CCL and toolstring.

MU and installed BHA #8 to perforate interval #6. Lowered 30 ft gun section, orientating weight and 20 ft gun section into lower riser section and hung off in C-plate. Connected and armed perforating guns according to Schlumberger procedure. Filled it with 180 ltrs of Ramex.

Bled down grease pressure and filled riser/lubricator with 270 ltrs of 100% MEG using cmt unit. Pressured up to 46 bar and equalized above HMV. Leak tested in-situ sub to 30/150 bar 5/10 min using Seawell pumpe and 100% MEG. Ok.
Open HMV and SV (44 turns). 50 bar WHP and 267 bar on DHPG. RIH with BHA #8 to perforate interval #6 from surface to 250 m. Powered up logging unit with guns 70 m below seabed.
RIH with BHA #8 from 250 to 3040 m. PU 50 m every 500 m due to new cable. Ran carefully through DHSV and pulled back up to confirm that it was fully open.
Performed correlation log from 3040 m to 2975 m using CCL. Had problems running back down to 3040 m because toolstring stopped in previous perforation interval #5, 3021-3036.2 m.
Seawell failed to stop on shooting depth twice and another correlation run had to be made because the guns had become off depth in the attempts.
Fired guns and perforated interval #6, from 3005 - 3020.2 m MDRT. Good indications of firing.
POOH with BHA #8 from 2980 m to 1562 m. Unable to move toolstring due to power shut down on WL winch.
Electrican opened ex-panel and re-sat main switch.
POOH with BHA #8 from 1562 m to 250 m. Powered down logging unit with guns 70 m below seabed.
Continued to POOH with BHA #8 from 250 m to OOH. WHP 67.3 bar and 267 bar on DHPG.
Held tool box meeting before operating valves due to new drilling- and production crews. Closed SV and HMV. Bled off XMT cross to 5 bar.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: Perforate well with BHA #8, interval #6 on WL. Inflow tested HMV and DHSV to SIWHP-5 bar. Started RD lubricator.

activities.remarks: Inflow tested HMV to 67-5 bar/10 min. Ok. Bled off pressure. Opened KWV and equalized and opened HMV using 100% MEG and cmt unit. Closed DHSV. Bullheaded 3 m3 100% MEG followed by 6.3 m3 of basoil at 500 lpm / 77 bar. Bled off pressure above DHSV to 5 bar and inflow tested DHSV to 67-5 bar for 30 min. Ok. Bled off pressure above DHSV to zero.
Closed HMV. Flushed XMT, riser and lubricator with nitrogen to closed drain.
Held tool box meeting prior to LO guns. Broke lubricator at in-situ sub and LD guns and toolstring. All shots fired.
Closed all XMT valves. Cut 7/16" cable and started to RD WL lubricator on rig floor.
RD lubricator and WL upper risers sections.
Removed scaffolding from WL BOP and shut down F-4 injection due to need of changing actuator.
RD WL BOP's and placed below moonpool hatch. Removed lower riser sections from XMT and lifted to rig floor.
Installed XMT tree cap. Transferred operation of HMV and DHSV from WL controlled panel to Mærsk production. Removed kill line hose and installed 1502 weco blind cap outside KWV.
Removed half moon hatch and lowered down actuator for F-4. Installed full hatch on F-14.

Leak tested tree cap, XMT cross and KWV cap to 35/345 bar for 5/10 min using Seawell pump and 100% MEG. Ok. Bled off pressure. 

Meanwhile removed WL BOP's from moonpool and performed skidding checks.

Performed well hand over activities. Verified that all valves on XMT and DHSV were closed. Meanwhile continued to remove WL equipment from rig floor. 

Handed well over to Maersk production at 18:00. ****************END OF OPERATIONS****************

daily_reports.remarks_combined: RD lubricator, risers and WL BOPs. Clean and clear rig floor. Leak tested tree cap, XMT cross and KWV cap. Handed over well to Mærsk production.
